title: Topic 3: Family & Relationships - Speaking
description: Recorded speaking task, teacher-graded against a 4-criterion rubric.

speakingTask.speakingPrompt:
Record yourself. Talk about 2 people in your family.
For each person say:
1. Who they are (This is my... / I have a...)
2. Their name (His name is... / Her name is...)
3. One more thing (age or city - remember Topic 2!)
Example: I have a sister. Her name is Julia. She is 15
years old. This is my father. His name is Marcos. He is
from Santos.

Tip: Choose the 2 people BEFORE you record.

teacherNotes: Source: tasilla_topic03_family_relationships.txt, Lesson 3.4. XP 15 on submit, +10 on approval.

criteria.title: Uses his/her correctly at least once
